title: A Light in the Attic
author: Shel Silverstein
summary: A collection of Shel Silverstein's short, silly poems with his own pen drawings, about odd creatures, bad habits, imagination and a few moments of tenderness, aimed at children but loved by adults too.
readIf: you want quick, funny verse to read aloud or revisit from childhood.
skipIf: you want serious, long-form poetry with dense imagery.
